message.content:
POSE 1: OK. Stable seated base, neutral spine, relaxed limbs.
POSE 2: ISSUE. Seated balance compromised; torso twisted awkwardly, limbs tangled.
POSE 3: ISSUE. Unstable single-leg perch; spine over-arched, shoulders hunched.
POSE 4: ISSUE. Improbable leg lift from seated position; hip angle unnatural.
POSE 5: OK. Dynamic but balanced; contrapposto stance, clear weight distribution.
POSE 6: ISSUE. Extreme spinal flexion; head/neck disconnected from body line.
